```python
def length(locations: List["Location"]=[], _3d: bool=False) -> float:
    if not locations:
        return 0
    length: float = 0
    for previous_location, location in zip(locations, locations[1:]):
        if _3d:
            d = location.distance_3d(previous_location)
        else:
            d = location.distance_2d(previous_location)
        if d:
            length += d
    return length
```
